Limo Lounge Party Sprinter

Scottsdale Sprinters is a Scottsdale chauffeured transportation company serving metro Phoenix. The Limo Lounge Party Sprinter is the largest, most spacious Sprinter in the fleet: four plush leather benches down each side, seating for sixteen, and room for thirty bags. It is a lounge first and a party second, and it does both.

Request a quoteCall to reserve

About the Limo Lounge Party Sprinter

Fiber-optic lighting, ceiling lights, strobes and lasers under a star-roof ceiling; four wet bars along the cabin; a full partition up front; and exterior ambient lighting for the arrival.

It is the Sprinter for the bar crawl, the prom night, the birthday that needs everyone in one cabin, and the group that travels with luggage.

Seats: Four plush leather benches on each side

Limo Lounge Party Sprinter rental in Scottsdale, Phoenix and Paradise Valley: chauffeured by the hour from $175 with a 4-hour minimum, or as a one-way airport and event transfer from $325. Seats 16, room for 30 bags.
